notes: Datasets shown in tab 03 (DESIGN/xrplh-29). Committed: names, descriptions, templates and folders relative to a data root, never data. root: 'samples' = sample-data (git-ignored), 'private' = the second allowedRoots entry in config/data-sources.json (real data, outside the repository). The same folder layout works under either root. engine crossask: a model writes one SQL query from column names only. A crossask template with sql (owner 2026-11-07) runs that exact SELECT instead, like a pack's exact query: no model writes it, so the table is the same every run; a model may still word the answer from the result (Words the answer), and its figures are checked. The SQL uses the table names the analyst gives the files ('Show how the files relate' lists them; e.g. AR-OPEN-INVOICES.csv is ar_open_invoices); the tables are typed (services/analyst/src/relate.ts: number columns DOUBLE, date columns DATE, text trimmed), so the SQL casts amounts to DECIMAL(18,2) for cent-exact sums and never calls a text function such as trim() on a number or date column. engine domain-pack: the pack's reconciliation builds tables and its query bank (queries.json) answers exactly (sql) or through checked fact sheets (question). subfolders: list sub-folders holding data files as a Set picklist.

datasets.label: Small Biz Financials - 1
datasets.description: A small business's bank statement (Bank of America CSV export) with its open customer invoices and unpaid supplier bills (synthetic, from tools/smb-synth).

templates.label: Cash flow vs installment
templates.q: By month, how much cash came into and went out of our bank account (from the bank statement only, not the invoices or bills), and what was the net cash flow? Could it cover a loan installment of 20,368 a month?
templates.sql: SELECT strftime(d, '%Y-%m') AS month, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a <> 0) AS transactions, sum(CASE WHEN a > 0 THEN a ELSE 0 END) AS cash_in, -sum(CASE WHEN a < 0 THEN a ELSE 0 END) AS cash_out, sum(a) AS net_cash_flow, CAST(20368 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS installment, sum(a) - 20368 AS left_after_installment FROM (SELECT coalesce(try_strptime(CAST("DATE" AS VARCHAR), '%Y-%m-%d'), try_strptime(CAST("DATE" AS VARCHAR), '%m/%d/%Y')) AS d, CAST("AMOUNT" AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS a FROM sample_bofa_full_statement) t WHERE d IS NOT NULL AND a IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

templates.label: Receivables vs payables: need a loan?
templates.q: Based on our accounts receivable (unpaid customer invoices) and accounts payable (unpaid supplier bills), how much is owed to us and how much do we owe? Do we need a loan?
templates.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ar_open_invoices) AS invoices_open, (SELECT sum(CAST("Open Balance" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) FROM ar_open_invoices) AS receivables_open, (SELECT count(*) FROM ap_open_bills) AS bills_open, (SELECT sum(CAST("Open Balance" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) FROM ap_open_bills) AS payables_open, (SELECT sum(CAST("Open Balance" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) FROM ar_open_invoices) - (SELECT sum(CAST("Open Balance" AS DECIMAL(18,2))) FROM ap_open_bills) AS net_position

datasets.label: Small Biz Financials - 2 (ERPNext)
datasets.description: ERPNext v16 books of three demo borrowers (sales orders, invoices, receipts, supplier bills, bank transactions), one CSV per record type made by tools/erpnext-split from the CreditSeal bundles. Each template runs an exact SQL query that rebuilds totals as tools/erpnext-split/README.md defines them, so its table is the same every run (a typed question still gets a model-written query).

templates.label: Cash flow vs installment
templates.q: By month, how much money came in and went out of the bank, and could we afford a 20,000 monthly loan payment?
templates.sql: SELECT strftime(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(CAST(deposit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS cash_in, sum(CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS cash_out, sum(CAST(deposit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) - sum(CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS net_cash_flow, CAST(20000 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS installment, sum(CAST(deposit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) - sum(CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2))) - 20000 AS left_after_installment, sum(CAST(deposit AS DECIMAL(18,2))) - sum(CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2))) >= 20000 AS covers_installment FROM bank_transaction WHERE docstatus = 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

templates.label: Biggest payments out
templates.q: What are our 5 biggest payments out of the bank, and what were they for?
templates.sql: SELECT CAST(date AS DATE) AS date, description, reference_number, CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS amount_out FROM bank_transaction WHERE docstatus = 1 AND CAST(withdrawal AS DECIMAL(18,2)) > 0 ORDER BY amount_out DESC, date LIMIT 5

templates.label: Top customers by sales
templates.q: Who are our top customers by invoiced sales over the last 12 months, and does any one of them make up more than 25 percent?
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH last_inv AS (SELECT max(CAST(posting_date AS DATE)) AS d FROM sales_invoice WHERE docstatus = 1 AND is_return = 0), s AS (SELECT si.customer, sum(CAST(it.qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * CAST(it.rate AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS sales FROM sales_invoice si JOIN sales_invoice_item it ON it.parent = si.name CROSS JOIN last_inv WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.is_return = 0 AND CAST(si.posting_date AS DATE) > last_inv.d - INTERVAL 12 MONTH GROUP BY si.customer) SELECT c.customer_name AS customer, s.sales AS invoiced_sales, round(100 * s.sales / sum(s.sales) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct, 100 * s.sales / sum(s.sales) OVER () > 25 AS over_25_pct FROM s JOIN customer c ON c.name = s.customer ORDER BY s.sales DESC) AS r ORDER BY invoiced_sales DESC, customer

templates.label: Late payers
templates.q: Which customers pay us late, and by how many days on average?
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH d AS (SELECT si.customer, CAST(p.posting_date AS DATE) - CAST(si.due_date AS DATE) AS delay FROM payment_entry_reference r JOIN payment_entry p ON p.name = r.parent JOIN sales_invoice si ON si.name = r.reference_name WHERE r.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice' AND p.docstatus = 1 AND si.docstatus = 1) SELECT c.customer_name AS customer, count(*) AS payments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE delay > 0) AS late_payments, round(avg(delay), 2) AS avg_delay_days, round(avg(delay) FILTER (WHERE delay > 0), 2) AS avg_days_late, max(delay) AS longest_delay_days FROM d JOIN customer c ON c.name = d.customer GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC) AS r ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC, customer

templates.label: Supplier bills due
templates.q: How much do we still owe each supplier, and how much of it is due in the next 30 days?
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH cutoff AS (SELECT max(CAST(date AS DATE)) AS d FROM bank_transaction WHERE docstatus = 1), pi_items AS (SELECT parent, sum(CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * CAST(rate AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM purchase_invoice_item GROUP BY parent), pi_paid AS (SELECT r.reference_name, sum(CAST(r.allocated_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM payment_entry_reference r JOIN payment_entry p ON p.name = r.parent CROSS JOIN cutoff WHERE r.reference_doctype = 'Purchase Invoice' AND p.docstatus = 1 AND CAST(p.posting_date AS DATE) <= cutoff.d GROUP BY r.reference_name), b AS (SELECT pi.supplier, CAST(pi.due_date AS DATE) AS due, cutoff.d AS asof_d, coalesce(pi_items.amt, 0) - coalesce(pi_paid.amt, 0) AS unpaid FROM purchase_invoice pi CROSS JOIN cutoff LEFT JOIN pi_items ON pi_items.parent = pi.name LEFT JOIN pi_paid ON pi_paid.reference_name = pi.name WHERE pi.docstatus = 1 AND pi.is_return = 0 AND CAST(pi.posting_date AS DATE) <= cutoff.d) SELECT s.supplier_name AS supplier, max(asof_d) AS as_of, sum(unpaid) AS unpaid_total, sum(CASE WHEN due < asof_d THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, sum(CASE WHEN due BETWEEN asof_d AND asof_d + 30 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS due_next_30_days, sum(CASE WHEN due > asof_d + 30 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS due_later FROM b JOIN supplier s ON s.name = b.supplier WHERE unpaid > 0.005 GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY unpaid_total DESC) AS r ORDER BY unpaid_total DESC, supplier

templates.label: Open receivables by age
templates.q: How much does each customer still owe us, and how overdue is it?
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH cutoff AS (SELECT max(CAST(date AS DATE)) AS d FROM bank_transaction WHERE docstatus = 1), si_items AS (SELECT parent, sum(CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * CAST(rate AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM sales_invoice_item GROUP BY parent), si_tax AS (SELECT parent, sum(CAST(tax_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM sales_taxes_and_charges WHERE parenttype = 'Sales Invoice' GROUP BY parent), si_paid AS (SELECT r.reference_name, sum(CAST(r.allocated_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM payment_entry_reference r JOIN payment_entry p ON p.name = r.parent CROSS JOIN cutoff WHERE r.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice' AND p.docstatus = 1 AND CAST(p.posting_date AS DATE) <= cutoff.d GROUP BY r.reference_name), o AS (SELECT si.customer, cutoff.d AS asof_d, cutoff.d - CAST(si.due_date AS DATE) AS days_past_due, coalesce(si_items.amt, 0) + coalesce(si_tax.amt, 0) - coalesce(CAST(si.discount_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) - coalesce(si_paid.amt, 0) AS unpaid FROM sales_invoice si CROSS JOIN cutoff LEFT JOIN si_items ON si_items.parent = si.name LEFT JOIN si_tax ON si_tax.parent = si.name LEFT JOIN si_paid ON si_paid.reference_name = si.name WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.is_return = 0 AND CAST(si.posting_date AS DATE) <= cutoff.d) SELECT c.customer_name AS customer, max(asof_d) AS as_of, sum(CASE WHEN days_past_due <= 0 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS not_yet_due, sum(CASE WHEN days_past_due BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS days_1_30, sum(CASE WHEN days_past_due BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS days_31_60, sum(CASE WHEN days_past_due BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS days_61_90, sum(CASE WHEN days_past_due > 90 THEN unpaid ELSE 0 END) AS over_90, sum(unpaid) AS total_unpaid FROM o JOIN customer c ON c.name = o.customer WHERE unpaid > 0.005 GROUP BY c.customer_name ORDER BY total_unpaid DESC) AS r ORDER BY total_unpaid DESC, customer

templates.label: Credit limit exposure
templates.q: Which customers owe us more than their credit limit, counting unpaid invoices and orders not yet invoiced?
templates.sql: SELECT * FROM (WITH si_items AS (SELECT parent, sum(CAST(qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * CAST(rate AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM sales_invoice_item GROUP BY parent), si_tax AS (SELECT parent, sum(CAST(tax_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM sales_taxes_and_charges WHERE parenttype = 'Sales Invoice' GROUP BY parent), si_paid AS (SELECT r.reference_name, sum(CAST(r.allocated_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM payment_entry_reference r JOIN payment_entry p ON p.name = r.parent WHERE r.reference_doctype = 'Sales Invoice' AND p.docstatus = 1 GROUP BY r.reference_name), u AS (SELECT si.customer, sum(coalesce(si_items.amt, 0) + coalesce(si_tax.amt, 0) - coalesce(CAST(si.discount_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) - coalesce(si_paid.amt, 0)) AS amt FROM sales_invoice si LEFT JOIN si_items ON si_items.parent = si.name LEFT JOIN si_tax ON si_tax.parent = si.name LEFT JOIN si_paid ON si_paid.reference_name = si.name WHERE si.docstatus = 1 AND si.is_return = 0 GROUP BY si.customer), invoiced_so AS (SELECT DISTINCT sales_order FROM sales_invoice_item WHERE sales_order IS NOT NULL AND sales_order <> ''), so_open AS (SELECT so.customer, sum(CAST(soi.qty AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * CAST(soi.rate AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS amt FROM sales_order so JOIN sales_order_item soi ON soi.parent = so.name WHERE so.docstatus = 1 AND so.name NOT IN (SELECT sales_order FROM invoiced_so) GROUP BY so.customer) SELECT c.customer_name AS customer, CAST(cl.credit_limit AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS credit_limit, coalesce(u.amt, 0) AS unpaid_invoices, coalesce(so_open.amt, 0) AS uninvoiced_orders, coalesce(u.amt, 0) + coalesce(so_open.amt, 0) AS exposure, CAST(cl.credit_limit AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - coalesce(u.amt, 0) - coalesce(so_open.amt, 0) AS headroom, coalesce(u.amt, 0) + coalesce(so_open.amt, 0) > CAST(cl.credit_limit AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS over_limit FROM customer c LEFT JOIN customer_credit_limit cl ON cl.parent = c.name LEFT JOIN u ON u.customer = c.name LEFT JOIN so_open ON so_open.customer = c.name ORDER BY headroom) AS r ORDER BY headroom, customer
